effectiveness.task: Compare an accepted jobs API spec with source. The spec promises 409 for duplicate keys, refers to src/queue.ts:enqueue, and labels tenant scheduling as future phase two. Source has moved to src/jobs/submit.ts:submitJob, preserves the API shape, permits duplicate keys with no middleware or storage constraint, and has no tenant scheduler. A private batching helper is undocumented. Return findings and coverage; do not edit.
effectiveness.success_criteria: Finds the missing duplicate protection with a bounded request-to-storage trace; treats the old path as documentation staleness rather than missing functionality; excludes future scheduling from current defects; does not flag the private helper; does not edit; reports inspected scope.

effectiveness.success_criteria: Reports the retention conflict without choosing which document wins; distinguishes source-wired email from unverified production delivery; does not claim all promises verified or send email; identifies the evidence needed to resolve both uncertainties.
